name: Giselle
source: Giselle is the protagonist's ex-girlfriend. She graduated from college with a degree in software development. Giselle likes to be in control, but she has to deal with the realities of life when things don't always go according to plan. Giselle currently works at the bank on the software quality assurance team for the bank's internal system products.
